chapter_title: Concept of Mole and Chemical Calculation

sections.content_markdown:
### Exercise

#### Multiple Choice Questions

1. What is the volume of 2 grams of hydrogen at standard conditions?

    a. $2.24\text{ liter}$

    b. $11.2\text{ liter}$

    c. $22.4\text{ liter}$

    d. $44.8\text{ liter}$

2. Which of the following is the formula of calcium phosphate?

    a. $\text{CaPO}_4$

    b. $\text{Ca}(\text{PO}_4)_2$

    c. $\text{Ca}_2(\text{PO}_4)_3$

    d. $\text{Ca}_3(\text{PO}_4)_2$

Answer questions 3 and 4 in the light of the following stem:

$5\text{ gram}$ hydrogen gas is passed on to $75\text{ gram}$ chlorine gas.

3. How many chlorine atoms are used in the reaction of the stem?

    a. $1.27 \times 10^{24}$

    b. $2.54 \times 10^{24}$

    c. $6.02 \times 10^{23}$

    d. $6.36 \times 10^{23}$

4. Which of the following is collected as remains in the reaction?

    a. $1.44\text{ mole } \text{H}_2$

    b. $1.44\text{ mole } \text{Cl}_2$

    c. $2.89\text{ mole } \text{H}_2$

    d. $2.89\text{ mole } \text{Cl}_2$

5. What is the volume of 17 grams of ammonia gas at standard conditions?

    a. $24.2\text{ liter}$

    b. $22.4\text{ liter}$

    c. $12.2\text{ liter}$

    d. $11.4\text{ liter}$
